arm_1_adaptive_memory.description: Full stateful adaptive multi-agent swarm with cross-agent shared attack memory and dynamic policy weighting.

arm_2_static_control.description: Non-adaptive multi-agent swarm with fixed budget (20) and static round-robin family preference.

arm_3_memory_disabled.description: Stateful multi-agent swarm with private agent state only; cross-agent shared attack memory disabled.

H1_adaptation_gain.rationale: Dynamic shifting away from blocked families towards memory-validated families increases overall evasion yield.

H2_shared_memory_gain.rationale: Cross-agent knowledge sharing accelerates discovery of target vulnerabilities across specialized agent roles.
